defects.detail: The starting event states 'The quarterly review meeting begins. The executive team is to discuss and decide on the balcony-panel pilot.' This pre-decides that the decision will be made during the meeting, but the question asks whether the decision is made and communicated by the end of the week. The scene should not assume the decision is made at the meeting; it could be made later in the week.

The resolution condition requires the decision to be communicated to the pilot team, but the scene does not include any mechanism for the pilot team to observe the decision (e.g., they are not present at the meeting). The resolution should be based on an observable event, such as a company-wide announcement or a direct communication record.
